title: Filename not percent-encoded in peer blob fetch URL
description: peer_fetch.rs:307-309 interpolates filename directly into the fetch URL string. Characters like '#' or '?' in a peer-supplied filename truncate or corrupt the URL path before it reaches the server. content_type gets partial encoding (%2F, %2B) but filename gets none. Fix: use percent_encoding::utf8_percent_encode on filename with a PATH_SEGMENT encode set before interpolating.
